description: This Java class 'MessagesRoute' defines HTTP route handling for message-related endpoints in an Akka HTTP server, including inbox/outbox, message sending, and claim message handling within the Eclipse Ditto project.

classes.name: MessagesRoute
classes.description: Defines HTTP routes for message operations such as inbox/outbox, message sending, and claim handling in an Akka HTTP server within the Eclipse Ditto project.

methods.name: buildThingsInboxOutboxRoute
methods.description: Constructs route for inbox/outbox endpoints related to specific things.

methods.name: buildFeaturesInboxOutboxRoute
methods.description: Constructs route for inbox/outbox endpoints related to specific features.

methods.name: claimMessages
methods.description: Handles the /inbox/claim route for submitting claim messages.

methods.name: thingMessages
methods.description: Handles message routes for specific thing IDs and message subjects.

methods.name: getMessageDirection
methods.description: Determines message direction (TO or FROM) based on inbox or outbox.

methods.name: featureMessages
methods.description: Handles message routes for specific features and message subjects.

methods.name: buildSendThingMessage
methods.description: Builds message command for sending messages to a thing.

methods.name: buildSendFeatureMessage
methods.description: Builds message command for sending messages to a feature.

methods.name: normalizeSubject
methods.description: Validates and normalizes message subject strings.

methods.name: buildSendClaimMessage
methods.description: Builds message command for claim messages.

methods.name: enhanceHeaders
methods.description: Enhances headers with timeout and channel info.

methods.name: initMessageBuilder
methods.description: Initializes message builder with payload and headers, validating size.

methods.name: handleMessage
methods.description: Processes incoming message payloads and sends appropriate commands.

methods.name: checkMessageTimeout
methods.description: Validates message timeout against maximum allowed.

methods.name: checkClaimTimeout
methods.description: Validates claim timeout against maximum allowed.
